definition: Placed in a position of power or authority.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: In both, there were several knots of loungers, squalid and miserable, but now with a manifest sense of power enthroned on their distress.
example_sentence: The cat sat enthroned on the warm laptop, ignoring all petitions.
